confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches of aggregated cost-of-living sites (citycost.org, nomadranker, livingcost.org, mylifeelsewhere, expatexchange). These sites gave inexpensive meals at about $6.7-9, cappuccinos at about $4-5.3 and draught or pub beer at about $3.9-4.4. Sources disagree widely on mid-range meals for two, from about $13 to $50. I used a figure near the upper cluster because the anchor is a three-course meal and Jeju is a tourist area. I did not search directly for cocktail or wine prices. Those anchors are based on typical Korean ratios to beer and bar norms, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for July, which is peak summer season, with no listings checked. They could vary by ±30%. The FX observation is the RBA AUD/USD reading at 4.00 pm on 18 November 2026, as reported in the search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices were checked against Busan and Seoul. Jeju restaurant prices run near or slightly above the Korean national average because of tourism. Accommodation is modelled on Busan's summer peak prices.
